elements.pathology_report: SURGICAL PATHOLOGY (synthetic). Right upper lobe wedge biopsy. Microscopy: invasive adenocarcinoma of the lung, acinar predominant, histologic grade 2. Margins negative. Lymphovascular invasion present.
elements.molecular_report: NGS PANEL (synthetic). Result: EGFR exon 19 deletion (p.E746_A750del) detected, variant allele fraction 32%. No ALK/ROS1 fusion. PD-L1 TPS 10%.
elements.imaging_text: CT CHEST (synthetic). 2.4 cm spiculated nodule right upper lobe. Ipsilateral hilar node 1.5 cm. No distant metastasis. Clinical stage cT2N1M0.
elements.prior_notes: Oncology clinic note (synthetic). 61-year-old former smoker, ECOG 1. Presented with persistent cough. No prior systemic therapy.
elements.meds: Current medications (synthetic): lisinopril 10 mg daily; atorvastatin 20 mg nightly.
